description:
The Job holder plays a role to support application/system, focusing on Core system for daily operation. Candidate is responsible for analyzing the business requirements, understanding IT systems/applications and communicating with internal/external stakeholder to ensure the smooth application/system operation. The job holder also ensures that the application/system issues can be solved on time.
* In charge of analyzing and preparing business and system requirements for the IT Lending Core systems
* Ensure proper due diligence and gap analysis is done for application implementation against the business requirements
* Work cohesively with the application vendor’s application supporters to get the required knowledge transfer for the product knowledge and business process.
* Providing system/application support for end user and know-how supports to internal teams.
* Managing and leveraging between end user’s expectation and the base lined business requirements
* Supporting User Acceptance Test for the project sign off.
* Project-management to implement of Lending Core system enhancement.
* Work with external vendor to follow up core system issues/enhancement.
* Configure the core system business rules for setup new products in core.
* Develop Core system APIs and other customization to fit to business needs.
* Support Core system operation (co-work with ICT operation team and ICT development team)
* Other tasks assigned by line manager, division head.
requirements_text:

* University Degree majored in Information Technology
2. Work Experience
* Minimum 05 years working experience in Software development and Application support.
* Have experience on business analysis and system analysis.
* Have experience on core banking, core securities or core lending system.
* Have experience in project management for projects related to core system/product development
* Have working experience in Finance/Banking/Insurance/Securities is a plus.
3. Knowledge
* Providing system/application support for end user and know-how supports to internal teams.
* Work with external vendor to follow up core system issues/enhancement.
* Experience on both Java, PL/SQL development
* Good experience on API development and system integration.
* Have knowledge on ITIL framework and process
4. Skills
* Good leadership skill for effective Team management
* Communication
* Problem-solving
* Effective application support
* Good collaboration
* Critical thinking
* Can-do attitude
* Time management
